title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobDescription:
Play a role in powering AstraZeneca and helping all of us to fulfil our ambitions. As valued partners across the enterprise, we provide the platform for excellence and performance to happen. We draw on our network of diverse minds, harnessing our unique views and ideas to improve how we run. It means every day we power ourselves and others to focus on important and impactful work.

As Chief Financial Officer (CFO) for AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited (AZPIL), a publicly listed entity of AstraZeneca Group, you will provide strategic financial leadership, stewardship, and governance that enable sustainable growth and uphold the highest standards of compliance, transparency, and corporate responsibility.

You will be a key member of the AstraZeneca Pharma India Board of Directors, responsible for advising the Board and the Managing Director on all financial, regulatory, and governance matters. The role encompasses end-to-end leadership of AZPIL’s financial strategy, statutory reporting, investor engagement, and internal control environment, ensuring that the listed entity operates with integrity, fiscal discipline, and alignment to AstraZeneca’s global standards.

Key Accountabilities

Strategic and Financial Leadership

  • Lead the overall financial strategy and performance of AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited (AZPIL), ensuring robust financial health, compliance, and value creation for shareholders.

  • Partner with the Managing Director and Leadership Team to drive growth, optimize resource allocation, and deliver sustainable profitability also ensuring strategic alignment and operational excellence.

  • Oversee financial planning, forecasting, and analysis processes to support both short- and long-term business objectives.
     Drive accountability, cost discipline, and return on investment across commercial, manufacturing, and enabling functions.

Board and Governance Responsibilities

  • Serve as a key member of the AZPIL Board of Directors, contributing to strategic deliberations and ensuring sound financial governance across all operations.

  • Present financial statements, forecasts, and performance updates to the Board and its committees, ensuring transparency and accuracy.

  • Ensure compliance with the Companies Act and other statutory requirements applicable to listed entities.

  • Collaborate closely with the Audit Committee and Risk Management Committee, to maintain strong governance and internal control frameworks.

  • Lead the statutory reporting process, ensuring timely submission of quarterly and annual financial results to the Board, stock exchanges, and regulatory bodies.

  • Oversee investor relations and public disclosures, ensuring AZPIL’s communications reflect financial clarity, regulatory compliance, and shareholder trust.

  • Safeguard the organization’s reputation by embedding ethical financial practices and fostering a strong compliance culture across the business.

Operational and Regulatory Excellence

  • Manage statutory audits, tax audits, and interactions with auditors, regulators, and financial institutions.

  • Drive continuous improvement in finance systems, reporting frameworks, and digital capabilities to enhance agility and transparency.

  • Work with regional finance teams to maintain alignment with AstraZeneca’s accounting, governance, and operational standards.

  • Support enterprise risk management, internal audit reviews, and remediation processes to ensure business continuity and compliance.

Leadership and People Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing Finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Mentor and develop talent within the function, ensuring succession readiness and capability for future leadership.

  • Promote AstraZeneca’s values of integrity, inclusion, and excellence, ensuring Finance operates as a trusted strategic partner to the business.

Education, Qualifications, and Experience

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) or equivalent professional qualification; MBA in Finance preferred. With 15 or more years of progressive Finance leadership experience, including within a listed company or regulated industry.

  • Strong understanding of financial governance, statutory compliance, taxation, and risk management frameworks.

  • Proven experience presenting to or advising Boards and Audit Committees.

  • Demonstrated success in managing external audits, financial reporting, and investor communication.

  • Experience working in a global matrix organization, managing cross-functional relationships.

Desirable

  • Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare industry.

  • Exposure to investor relations and capital market communications.

  • Familiarity with AstraZeneca’s global financial and governance processes.

AstraZeneca is driven by solutions that make an impact at every step of the patient journey. We thrive on energy and pace, always pushing forward with a winning mentality. Our inclusive team draws on a diverse group of backgrounds to come up with innovative solutions. Here you will find countless opportunities to develop and grow while contributing to life-saving medicines.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

title: Lead - Diagnostics & Health Innovation Hub
jobDescription:
Typical Accountabilities 

• Ensure that Diagnostic Manager and diagnostic liaison objectives are met at a national level by setting clear goals in alignment with organizational priorities. 
 
• Develop a strategy for adoption of companion diagnostic testing, including defining metrics to measure success. 
 
• Identify and build relationships with key scientific stakeholders such as laboratory decision makers, anatomical and molecular pathologists, and other healthcare professionals. 
 
• Provide approved, relevant educational material on diagnostics to enhance understanding and competency among clinical laboratory leaders and their staff. 
 
• Deliver highly technical presentations on data related to diagnostics and testing. 
 
• Educate on the importance of diagnostic quality assurance (QA) programs to ensure high standards in testing processes. 
 
• Partner with diagnostic companies, lab networks, and healthcare professionals to identify and resolve barriers to diagnostic testing, driving accessibility and efficiency. 
 
• Develop tailored strategies that support and educate on appropriate diagnostic testing practices. 
 
• Align actions with broader business plans and assess the impact of external market trends and regulatory changes on organizational strategies to adapt accordingly. 
 
• Work alongside customers and sales teams in the field to influence customer perceptions and reinforce the value of the brand portfolio. 
 
• Focus on delivering on high-impact opportunities by implementing customer-specific approaches based upon their needs and preferences. 
 
• Demonstrate exceptional awareness of both situational contexts and individual motivations, using this insight to influence stakeholders effectively and drive results. 
 
• Use robust analytical methods to identify issues and opportunities early, integrating new perspectives to refine solutions and strategies. 
 
• Anticipate and eliminate potential obstacles to ensure that teams can focus on delivering impactful results efficiently. 
 
• Lead, coach, and develop Diagnostics Managers and liaisons, defining clear roles, responsibilities and business objectives, and fostering professional growth and engagement. 
 
• Adhere to compliance standards, including the AZ Code of Conduct, Market Policy Handbook, and other regulatory guidelines, ensuring the highest ethical accountability in all professional activities. 

Qualifications and Skills 

  • Essential: Undergraduate life sciences/medical degree required (advanced degree preferred); Minimum of 5 years of experience in diagnostic or pharmaceuticals; Proven management experience in field; Strong teamwork and collaboration skills; Excellent communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally with market-based and global partners; Ability to identify strategies with the greatest business impact, formulate appropriate business plans, and lead teams to execute them; Demonstrated leadership and communication competencies; Experience in managing budgets; Thorough understanding of customer segments and market dynamics within the diagnostic area; Ability to lead, manage, and develop staff; Previous successful experience in customer support environments; Demonstrated presentation and negotiation skills. 

  • Desirable: Proven track record of strategic thinking, judgment, and influencing skills; Demonstrated ability to influence national internal teams and customers to ensure a strong focus with excellent execution; Proven experience in developing compelling business cases; Extensive experience in a launch environment; Strong leadership attributes to set direction, generate commitment, balance short- and long-term needs, and constructively resolve issues; Proven ability to demonstrate effective cross-functional leadership; Advanced Degree PHD,MD or MBA and/or prior experience in multiple functions 

Key Relationship to Reach Solutions 

  • Internal: Senior management team; Business leaders; Cross functional partners. 

  • External: Diagnostic partners; Regulatory bodies.

title: Senior Consultant – Python Progtamming (Full Stack)
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Consultant – Python Progtamming (Full Stack)

Career Level: D2

Are you ready to harness modern engineering to help transform how life-changing medicines reach patients? Join a high-impact team building secure, scalable products that turn data into better decisions across our business. Your work will shorten feedback loops, increase the reliability of critical platforms and directly influence how quickly we can move from scientific discovery to real‑world outcomes.

Operating at a senior level, you will own complex services end to end, from shaping solution architecture to hands-on coding, testing and deployment. You will raise the engineering bar through clean code, robust patterns and strong DevOps practices—while collaborating closely with product, architecture and data teams to deliver value in short, measurable increments.

Do you thrive on taking ideas from whiteboard to production, instrumenting what matters and iterating fast? This is a chance to lead by example in an Agile environment, aligning modern Python, React/Next.js and AWS-native capabilities to solve meaningful problems at scale.

Accountabilities:

- Product-Focused Delivery: Translate outcomes into clear increments with product and data partners; plan and execute delivery within Agile/Scrum ceremonies to create measurable impact.

- Backend Services (Python/FastAPI): Design and build secure, scalable APIs and microservices; apply async I/O and multithreading where it adds throughput and reliability; enforce robust error handling, logging and performance optimization.

- Frontend Engineering (React/Next.js/TypeScript): Build responsive, accessible components and pages; optimize for performance, maintainability and reuse; integrate modern UI patterns.

- API and Systems Integration: Integrate frontend apps with backend systems and external services; implement and harden authentication/authorization flows using JWT and OAuth.

- Cloud-Native Operations (AWS/EKS): Containerize services with Docker; implement CI/CD with GitHub and ArgoCD; apply IAM best practices; design for resilience, observability and cost efficiency.

- Data and Storage: Model, query and optimize against PostgreSQL and Snowflake; ensure data integrity and reliability in high-traffic scenarios.

- Quality and Reliability: Drive a testing culture with Pytest and Jest; lead code reviews and refactoring; champion secure coding and progressive hardening of services.

- Engineering Excellence: Apply OOP, SOLID, DRY and KISS; design modular, testable architectures; establish reusable patterns and internal libraries to accelerate delivery across teams.

- Ways of Working and Mentorship: Contribute to a culture that embraces AI and modern digital tools to improve outcomes; coach peers, share knowledge and help scale best practices across squads.

- Business Impact: Reduce lead time and defects, improve system uptime and user experience, and ensure solutions align to strategic priorities that speed and strengthen decision-making across the enterprise.

Essential Skills/Experience:

- We’re looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 8 to 10 of experience and strong expertise in Python backend development and ReactJS / Next.js frontend development to join our team.

- 5+ years of skill relevanyt experience in full stack development

- Strong backend experience in Python using FastAPI (must), Flask (good to have).

- Frontend expertise in ReactJS, Next.js, and TypeScript

- Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs

- Strong understanding of authentication and authorization using JWT and OAuth

- Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake

- Knowledge of microservices, multithreading, and async I/O

- Experience with Docker, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and ArgoCD

- Testing experience using Pytest and Jest

- Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum teams

- Strong AWS knowledge is required, including EKS, IAM, S3, and Identity Management and ability to articulate them clearly.

- Strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and software design principles

- Practical experience applying SOLID principles, DRY, KISS, and clean coding practices

- Ability to write modular, reusable, scalable, and maintainable code

- Experience with code reviews, refactoring, and improving code quality over time

- Good understanding of design patterns, separation of concerns, and writing testable application architecture

- Focus on error handling, logging, performance optimization, and secure coding practices

Desirable Skills/Experience:

- Exposure to Agile.

- Familiarity with modern UI libraries or styling frameworks such as Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS

title: Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM
jobDescription:
Role Title: Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM

Location: Chennai

We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.

AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.

The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.

The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.

The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.

What you’ll do

This role supports the technical solution design for Operational Transfer Pricing and other Tax capabilities or part of a cross functional component. The role is a key position on the Axial Programme IT design team taking a central role in defining the global design template for AstraZeneca in line with our ambition of Fit to Standard using SAP best practice as far as possible. You will be a member of a wider Axial IT Design Team that will lead on defining the IT solution that will support our global standardised business processes. Ensuring integration between business process definition, SAP solution definition and SAP data objects definition.

In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that the global standard solution is fully and accurately documented and tested according to project standards and will guide the core design through the required governance forums. You will work closely with IT Enterprise Business Partners, others IT Product Managers and SMEs across the design team to ensure that solutions are efficiently integrated into a wider AstraZeneca global standard design. This will also include working with SMEs from our external partners to ensure that the AZ solution adopts standard and groundbreaking technology in fulfilling business capabilities and outcomes.

As the project moves to the deployment phase you will continue to play a pivotal role in ensuring that the localisation requirements of individual operating units are properly represented in the solution, whilst retaining the integrity of a fit to standard best practice template. You will also support the deployment teams with deploying the business change journey and ensuring successful migration and cutover to the standard design for each entity. You will be a key participant in hypercare management, ensuring that any issues related to your capability are resolved in a timely and effective way.

In the role of SAP PaPM Consultant, you will apply knowledge of SAP best practices to enable core business capability and a standard global template for your respective domain.

PaPM is a new SAP capability and as such not all potential candidates may have the necessary skill sets. However, if you have a good functional knowledge within the domain or experience with other technologies mentioned in this role profile, then please apply as AstraZeneca can support your career development.

Essential for the role

  • Good functional knowledge/experience in Operational transfer pricing, financial performance and analytics and financial allocation processes

  • Experience and knowledge in one or more mentioned SAP technologies: SAP PAPM (Required), SAP Datasphere (Preferred), SAP SAC (Optional) and SAP HANA Modelling (Optional)

  • Understanding of defining the data models in PaPM, integration of finance actuals, forecasting (SAP and non-SAP systems), standard capabilities in PaPM and design of business rule

  • Handle multiple data sources, data objects and integrate them effectively

  • Creation and review of technical design documentation addressing user requirements

  • Confident to challenge the status quo and facilitate different perspectives to drive solutions

  • Able to think out of the box, thrive in ambiguous and stressful situations

  • Understanding of Cost and Revenue allocation process design and implementation

Desirable for the role

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and possessing an agile and open approach.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to prioritise efficiently to ensure project goals are achieved.

  • Skilled in business operations, communications, customer and partner engagement.

  • Understanding of various transfer pricing calculation methods , P&L Segmentation, monitoring, true-ups process design and implementation

  • Understanding of supply chains of multinationals and how they are reflected in system landscapes

  • Understanding of SAP FICO, SAP SD & MM pricing

Why AstraZeneca?

At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imaging yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.

  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and hope its yours

  • If you’re curious to know more then we welcome your application. Apply now!

title: Senior Consultant- SAP FICO
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Consultant - SAP FICO

Career Level: D2

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to turn deep SAP FI/CO expertise into business outcomes that help speed life-changing medicines to patients? Join a team that marries purposeful work with high-tech platforms, where your functional mastery and technical know-how power core financial processes at global scale.

You will be the go-to consultant translating business needs into robust SAP solutions—keeping our procure-to-pay and order-to-cash financial flows accurate, compliant and fast. Backed by significant investment and a modern technology environment, you will tackle complex integrations, streamline interfaces and elevate data quality so our scientists and clinicians can focus on what matters most.

Can you see yourself owning critical integrations and shaping how we demonstrate SAP to scale across markets while unlocking new levels of efficiency and insight?

Accountabilities:

  • Issue Resolution and Continuous Improvement: Triage, analyze and resolve SAP FI/CO issues reported by business users; identify root causes and deliver fixes that improve stability, control and user experience.

  • Change and Enhancement Delivery: Gather requirements, design and configure solutions, manage testing and deploy enhancements that meet business needs and regulatory standards.

  • Integration Ownership: Lead and optimize p2p to fi and fi to Sotc integrations; ensure interfaces, Idocs and Z developments deliver reliable, reconciled, end-to-end financial data flows.

  • Collaborator Engagement: Partner with finance, procurement and operational teams to capture requirements, set expectations and provide timely progress updates and user guidance.

  • Quality and Documentation: Produce clear functional specifications, test plans and user documentation; support knowledge transfer and adoption.

  • Delivery Rigor: Complete tasks assigned by the team lead and project coordinator on time; manage risks, dependencies and change/release cycles with rigor.

  • Data and Controls: Safeguard data integrity across FI/CO processes; support period-end close, reconciliations and audit/controls readiness.

  • Future-Ready Finance: Contribute to automation, analytics and cloud-enabled improvements that elevate performance and reduce manual effort over time.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • 7-9 years of experience and functional knowledge in their domain and good technical knowledge in the FI and CO modules.

  • Work experience in core modules of FI&CO, p2p to fi & fi to Sotc integrations, Interfaces, wbs, Idocs, z developments etc.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Experience working as a Functional Consultant resolving SAP issues and delivering change/enhancements for business users.

  • Hands-on exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance and/or Central Finance migration or greenfield initiatives.

title: Senior Consultant - SAP Transportation Management
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Consultant - SAP Transportation Management

Career Level: D2

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to build a global S/4HANA Transportation Management (TM) platform that keeps life-changing medicines moving to patients? Can you turn sophisticated TM challenges into a simple, standardized solution for a growing enterprise? This is your opportunity to lead with impact.

Based in Chennai, you will be a Senior Consultant in our Order, Dispatch to Cash capability, designing and delivering SAP TM solutions that underpin the reliable distribution of materials and finished goods across our global operations. Your work will directly enable on-time, cost-efficient, and process compliant delivery from site-to-site and to external customers, improving visibility and accelerating supply to patients.

You will partner with enterprise process leaders and multi-functional teams to harness S/4HANA standard features, integrate with adjacent modules and non-SAP systems, and scale robust processes globally. Bring your 8–10 years of SAP experience to a modern, data-led environment where you will drive standards, reduce customizations, and create measurable business value.

Accountabilities:

  • SAP TM Solution Ownership: Design and lead the global S/4HANA Embedded TM solution for Order, Dispatch to Cash, ensuring it enables standardized processes for material movements between sites and finished goods' distribution to distribution centres and external customers.
  • Process Design and Integration: Lead process design with business teams aligned to SAP standard functionality; integrate TM with BN4L, S/4 core modules, and external partners to create end-to-end, resilient flows from transportation planning through carrier invoice settlement.
  • Innovation and Standards: Continuously evaluate the latest industry and SAP capabilities; adopt new features that improve planning, execution, monitoring, and cost control while minimizing local customization.
  • Domain Expertise: Serve as a primary guide in TM sub-processes, including freight unit and order management, freight cost calculation, and settlement; guide decisions with clear rationale and data.
  • Process Improvement: Define, analyze, and communicate current, interim, and future-state processes; identify and prioritize improvement opportunities tied to service, cost, and compliance outcomes.

  • Documentation and Knowledge: Create clear process maps and design documentation; facilitate sharing of knowledge and capability uplift across teams and regions.
  • Deployment and Change Enablement: Plan and support deployments, testing, and organizational change activities to secure adoption and measurable benefits.
  • Collaborator Leadership: Build influential, collaborative relationships across regions and functions; communicate with clarity to align diverse collaborators and accelerate delivery.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • S/4HANA TM Certified and implementation experience for sophisticated global organizations from design to completion.
  • Experience of pharmaceutical supply chain business activities and the required business outcomes within the relevant capability area
  • Significant experience in TM, which includes complete transportation planning and execution with deep knowledge of freight units and order management, freight cost and settlement management.
  • Good Hands-on experience implementing SAP BN4L and integrating it with S/4HANA Embedded TM
  • Demonstrate high degree of knowledge in SAP S/4HANA TM configuration requirements.

  • Solid skills in understanding business operations, communications, customer and partner engagement, and internal collaborator management
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and possessing an agile and open outlook.
